# Test fixtures: all made up

Every review in these folders is **synthetic, written for the tests**. None comes from a real person or a real store listing. That includes the names (e.g. "Rahul Sharma"), phone numbers, PAN, Aadhaar, UPI and account numbers.

| Folder | What it is |
|---|---|
| `app_store/` | Pages shaped like Apple's public review feed; author fields are set to `REDACTED` |
| `raw/` | Small raw exports (BOM, CRLF, UTF-16, messy ratings) used by the ingest tests |
